Compare actual GDS bounds and area, including controller, registers, replica, latch and macro pins
Compare actual active/poly gate count and area with source and frozen baseline
Record bridge counts and native interface conductor audit
Limited M1-M10 minimum-width/spacing and opposite-well overlap/nonzero225nm spacing checks

adaptive_stop_policy: A fallback may be stopped once a smaller candidate for the same size completes the required physical checks; report it as stopped, never as a physical pass
